title: harden the Thor validator pipeline — ordered gate stages with audit
task_body: Thor (Layer 4 validator) needs an ordered pipeline of gate stages so refusals are explainable and reproducible. Carve out a pipeline module, route the orchestration there, add a hardening test that enumerates every gate stage in a deterministic order.
rationale: New pipeline module + the thor.rs orchestrator that consumes it; lib.rs re-exports; the hardening test enumerates stages.
